method: Equal-weight delivery milestones: 100 * delivered / 20. Partial or unverified milestones count zero. These are delivery checklist percentages, not hardware accuracy, exhaustive domain coverage or retail compatibility.

milestones.acceptance: Separate core plugin and ABI entry points
Parse a native cartridge/executable format (boot scored separately)
Complete CPU instruction families, including architectural extensions
Complete native RAM/ROM map and ownership rules
Complete exceptions, privilege and address translation
Complete peripheral registers, interrupt producers and DMA
Native firmware/retail boot procedure
At least one locally tested retail title verified playable
Guest graphics produce rendered video
Guest sound produces audio samples
Hardware-referenced CPU/device/display/audio timing
Native digital controller/keypad registers consume frontend input
Complete native controller/touch/motion/analog peripheral behavior
Native local multiplayer/link input routing
Actual production-plugin TCP peers pass original guest oracle and whole-state comparison
Complete native persistent media types and persistence
Complete states for the implemented profile and deterministic replay
Repository-owned ROM source and reproducible archived image
Actual guest register-file output independently graded on the host, with negative controls
Original corpus covers the full native hardware, with physical reference validation

platforms.name: Nintendo 64
platforms.remaining: Super Mario 64 passes SET_Z_IMAGE and real color/depth-buffer clears, then reaches the 200-million-attempt trace bound without a terminal CPU fault. RSP comparisons/clipping and ordinary integer arithmetic/logic now pass; RDP SET_TILE and RSP VRCPH remain blocked; video stays uniform. Native boot/playability, full CPU/CP0/devices, FPU physical timing, RSP reciprocal/square-root/move and rare operations, complete RDP/audio, hidden coverage/depth bits, analog and netplay remain.
